Class ResBlock

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.core.nn.ResBlock
public final class ResBlock extends Object
A residual feed-forward block, x + W2 relu(W1 LN(x)), the building block SimBa (Lee et al., ICLR 2025) scales reinforcement-learning networks with: the layer norm keeps what the block sees at one scale however the network below it grows, and the skip path keeps a plain way through.

Its output layer starts at zero, so a block added to a trained network leaves everything that network computes exactly as it was (Net2Net's function-preserving growth, Chen et al., ICLR 2016, in its simplest form). The first update moves the output layer, and from then on the gradient reaches the rest of the block through it.

    • backward

      public void backward(float[] dx, int off, ResBlock.Cache c, float[][] grads)
      On entry dx[off .. off+width) is the gradient with respect to the block's output; on exit it is the gradient with respect to its input (the skip path plus the branch). Parameter gradients are added to grads. Must follow forward(float[], int, ResBlock.Cache) with the same cache.
